1) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic __and/or is an indole derivative of a similar structure__ and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof. (Currently amended)

3) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action __for treatment__. (Currently amended)

4) Composition according to one or more of Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight. (Original)

6) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient __one or more of ectoine or an equivalent}__, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight. (Currently amended)

7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __suitable for the treatment of skin or hair conditions__. (Currently amended)

8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of skin diseases which are associated with __and including but not limited to__ defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, in particular for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation, in particular ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo- plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component, __and those related to the skin, mucous membranes and nails__ including all forms of psoriasis, as well as for use in skin atopy conditions. (Currently amended)

9) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development. (Original)

10) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair __particularly for counteracting the effects of aging or damage__. (Currently amended)

11) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as __potential__ skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent. (Currently amended)

12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for __achieving__ skin lightening and/or skin whitening. (Currently amended)

13) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, __wrinkles, fine lines, hyper-pigmentation, or textural irregularities__. (Currently amended)

14) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, in particular for prophylaxis against dry skin, wrinkle formation __and/or pigmentation irregularities__, and/or for the reduction or prevention of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin. (Currently amended)
